description: Import a dictionary the user already has (Wispr Flow CSV, Superwhisper JSON, macOS Text Replacement plist, espanso YAML, markdown (the CLAUDE.md '## Voice lexicon' table or '- **Canonical**: aliases' bullets), plain text 'Canonical: alias1, alias2', generic CSV, or a lexicon JSON/YAML) into the lexicon. Pass either path (a file on disk, resolved from the server working directory) or content (the text itself, up to 8 MB of UTF-8). With both, content is imported and path is not read: only its file name is used, so its extension steers format 'auto' (content passed with a .csv path is parsed as CSV). `path` must be inside the server directory, its git root, a client root or LEXICON_HARVEST_ROOTS; anything else is refused with the command the user can run themselves. Use dryRun: true first to show the user what would be added, then run again without it. With scope project and a project file that is not trusted yet, the file is written but left untrusted (`trusted: false`): relay `nextStep`. A dry run against such a file does not read it, so its rows carry no `created` (the report has `untrustedTarget: true`).

content.description: The dictionary text, when the file is not on this machine: at most 8388608 bytes (8 MB) of UTF-8. Must not be blank.

dryRun.description: Report what would be added without writing.

path.description: File to import. Its extension helps auto-detection. Alongside content it is not read, and only its extension and name are used.

name: import_dictionary
title: Import an existing dictionary
